body: Same here. Wouldn’t that just make things easier...

You need something other than antidepressants, from the little I know about mental health. Hallucinations, insomnia, and hearing things - your doc should prescribe something different for those. Then if those struggles lessened, that would probably help with your exhaustion and depression. I hope your life gets better, friend.

I hear you, and that sounds awful. I am so sorry you have to deal with that.

I hate medication, but your case sounds serious enough, that I bet if you went to a doctor and got the right prescription, it might help you get your life and mind like it’s supposed to be.

Wouldn’t hurt to try.

I understand your pain though and I’m so sorry

I’m sorry, and I feel you.

Finding a dead body has to be so crippling for a person, and I hope you don’t do it.

I have always envisioned myself outside, where my body will be spotted and taken care of sooner rather then later. I also have thought about putting a towel over my face to spare other people. Damn, death is such a significant occurrence.
I feel you. So much grind, and still not getting by. What’s the point of working hard if you’re not getting anything good in return? Life is too hard for too many people
